book.name: 1 TIMOTEO
book.title: 1 TIMOTEO Timoteo qui Pablonen raanni joi

content: Jaa copi tah hen nea pari mato yohihi. Papa yocanahue. Pishinaibo yocaxonnahue, Papan jato hahxonti pishinaibo rihbi yocaxonquin. Jan hahxonai copi Hahxon tah min jato jai Papan hihnahue, jatihibichina.

Quiquin hapobo yocaxonxon texe hapobo rihbi yocaxonnahue, non raquetaxma sca jihuenon hihxon, rehtenanaibo jayamanon hihxon rihbi, shinan siriyabo non jihuenon hihxon rihbi. Papahon shinanhahnan non siripi jihuenon hihxon rihbi yocaxonquin.
Non jascajaquin Papa yocaxona ta siri qui. Non jascajati cahen noque jihuemanica noquen Papa queenih.
Jaan ta jatihibi jonibo teehihmacatsihquiqui, hahan jihuemati joi jato nincacoinmaquin.
Jaa huesti ta naihoh queha Papa qui. Noquen Papa janinxon noque yocaxonai ta huesti rihbi qui, jonihax bi Jesucristo. Jaan ta noque noquen Papan joi yohihiqui.
Jatihibi noquebo queyoyamanox manatahbo hihquish ta hinamehnishqui noquen hohcha copi mahuanoxon. Jonibo nincamati siriscaiya ta jaa joi Papan nincamascanishqui.

Hen jascajanon hihxon ta hea caisnishqui, jahuen joi yohicoinnon hihxon, jahuen raanti joni rihbi hea janon hihxon. Hihcoin tah hen jai. Quesayamahi. Judiomabo honanmanica hea janon hihxon ta hea caisnishqui, Papan joi coin yohixon hean jato nincacoinmanon.
Jatihibi janinxon bebobaan noquen Papa yocati jato honanmahue. Sinaxonma, join bahchinnanxonma, hohchajomaxon, jatihixonbi noquen Papa yocacahbo tah hen yohihi.

Haibobo rihbi yohihue. Chopa siribo sahueresnahue, haibobon. Chopa sirihax bi hahan tsinitima. Hahan tsiniti bohuexetijoma janahue. Oro morobo, copi joxo morobo, copi chopabo shinanyamanahue. Jascapahbo shinanquinma bi jato yanapannoxon caibo hahxonti shinannahue. Papahon shinanai haibobaan ta jascajanicah qui hahquin jato yohihue.
Tsinquitaibo tocan haibobo netexon nincacahbo jato haxemahue.
Haibobaan ta bebobo honanmatimahiqui. Bebo yonoyamarihbiquin. Netexon nincacoinahbo jato yohihue.
Adan pari ta Papan jonijanishqui. Jaa pecaho cahen Eva.
Adan ta Satanasnen paranyamanishqui. Jahuen haibo caya ta parannishqui. Paranah hohchayahpascai.
Jaabi ta haibobo Papan teehihmayaxihquiqui, baquebo bihxon hanijahanan shinancoinquin jeneyamahiboya, joni huetsahon shinanquin jeneyamahiboya, tsinixonma Papahon shinanquin jeneyamahiboya.
